query:
SELECT r.id as residentId, r.firstName, r.lastName, 
       p.id as packageId, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.isActive
FROM residents r
LEFT JOIN packages p ON p.residentId = r.id AND p.isActive = true
WHERE r.firstName LIKE '%test%'
ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 1;
